Hi Elena / Sam 

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Scope: You confirmed Acme Health will use Redwood to power clinical admin assistance (no PHI is routed to Redwood in the initial pilot; will confirm retention settings).
- Compliance asks: You requested our current SOC 2 status, a draft DPA, and guidance on which SCC module we recommend for Acme Health (controller-controller vs controller-processor mapping).
- Timeline: You indicated legal/compliance hopes to wrap initial review by next Friday (9/4).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Attaching a draft DPA for your legal team to review (Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf). This is our standard DPA with options flagged for preferred SCC modules.
2) Attached SCC mapping spreadsheet (SCC_module_mapping.xlsx) — high level recommendation: we typically propose using the Controller-Controller path only when the customer is using data processing features that require joint controllership. For your use case (Redwood hosted inference with strict retention controls + tenant-level isolation), our recommendation leans to Controller (Acme Health) / Processor (Redwood) with SCC Module 2/Module 3 supplemental clauses as needed. See sheet tab "Recommendation".
3) Rishi will follow up on SOC 2 timeline and provide a status update and expected report delivery date.
4) If you want us to start the vendor security questionnaire, confirm the DocuSign/HIPAA question set and we’ll loop our security team.

If that aligns, I’ll send the DPA + SCC notes to your legal contact (cc’ing Rishi and Neha) and we can set a short sync with legal this week.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A couple of clarifying Qs from legal: 

1) PHI/HIPAA: My team flagged the need to confirm whether any protected health information will be processed in the pilot. In your call notes you mentioned "no PHI in initial pilot" — can you confirm how that will be enforced (data filters? PII scrubbing?) and whether Redwood would sign a BAA if needed?

2) SCC modules: Our privacy lead prefers Controller-Controller only when there is co-determination of purposes. Based on your description we are leaning to Controller-Processor too, but would appreciate the specific rationale and which SCC modules (1-5) you recommend.

3) SOC 2: Can Rishi confirm whether Redwood is SOC 2 Type II and when the most recent report is dated? We will need a copy for our vendor onboarding.

We can do a 30-min legal sync either Thursday (8/31) afternoon or Friday (9/1) morning — which works on your side?

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the questions. Short answers below, and happy to expand on the call.

1) PHI/HIPAA: Per the notes, the pilot is scoped to administrative workflows and we will implement a strict input filter at ingestion to drop known PHI markers. We also offer customer-side filtering and allow customers to configure token retention to "0" for sensitive fields. If Acme expects any PHI to be processed, Redwood can sign a BAA; we’ve executed BAAs with other healthcare customers. Let us know if your legal prefers a draft BAA to review alongside the DPA.

2) SCC modules: Our recommended baseline for your deployment (hosted inference, customer-managed retention settings, no shared dataset training) is Controller (Acme) / Processor (Redwood). For SCC selection: Module 2 (Controller-Processor) is the typical mapping for cloud-hosted inference services. We included a recommended mapping in SCC_module_mapping.xlsx — key considerations: purpose limitation, sub-processor list, and data export mechanics. If there is any co-determination (e.g., joint analytics on combined datasets), we can discuss Controller-Controller terms.

3) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. Latest report period ended 2026-06-30. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA or through your secure portal — expected availability for delivery: 3 business days after a standard NDA. I’ll loop in our security ops for the questionnaire.

Proposed legal sync: Thursday 8/31, 3:00–3:30 PM PT. If that works, Marissa can send the calendar invite and we’ll have Neha and our security ops engineer on the call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
